title: pentanema mariae
intro: Pentanema mariae, commonly known as the Mary's Gold, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is a shrubby perennial herb with yellow flowers and is native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Pentanema mariae include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Pentanema mariae include its ability to act as a nervine, astringent, and antiseptic, and its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
